messages:
Jia T.: Oncall Bot just paged for a p95/p99 divergence on chat/completions routes, looks like tail-only. Paging at 1765550000.
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: Incident: LATENCY_TAIL_CHAT (p99) > 900ms for 5m on routes: chat-large, completions-lowlatency. Models: [redweave-v2, sylph-2b]. Pager: @Jia T., @Rafael M. Runbook: latency-tail-response.
Rafael M.: I'm in. Initial metric: p50 ~120ms, p95 ~240ms, p99 jumped to 980-1.1s on two routes. QPS steady. No error spike.
Priya V.: Customer-facing note: some webchat sessions reported UI stutter. Small set but reproducible. I flagged key accounts.
SRE Bot: Auto-checks: autoscaler ok, GPU mem ok, pod restarts 0, network dropouts 0. KV cache hit-rate unchanged.
Jia T.: Suspect: model variant fallback churn? Or a recent kernel tweak in runtime. Quick mitigations: 1) suppress noisy p99 pager 2) change alert to require delta vs baseline + absolute floor 3) flip route routing policy to prefer quantized_fallback for non-critical traffic.
Rafael M.: I prefer (2) + (3). Squelching is fine short-term but we need better gating so on-call isn't paged for normal diurnal spikes on low-volume routes.
InfraOps: Can spin a targeted pool with lighter batching to lower latency tail for these routes. Will take ~90s.
Jia T.: Doing both: SRE Bot apply squelch for 10m (targeted), InfraOps start light-pool. Rafael please draft alert rewrite.
Oncall Bot: Squelch applied to LATENCY_TAIL_CHAT for routes [chat-large, completions-lowlatency] duration=10m id=sup-1765550000.
InfraOps: Light pool created at 1765550150, moved 20% of traffic for the two routes to the new pool. Monitoring.
Rafael M.: Draft alert (pseudo):
```
# new alert semantics
p99 = histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model))
baseline = rolling_median(p99, 7d, route, model)

alert when:
  p99 > max(baseline + 0.35, 0.9) and
  p99 > baseline * 1.25
for: 5m
page only if route.volume > 100/min OR delta > 300ms
```
Will include low-volume suppression and an explicit per-model override map for known slow quantized variants.
Priya V.: Please include a customer-impact label on the alert so paging policy can escalate to product on regressions affecting top accounts.
Rafael M.: Good call. Adding labels: {severity, customer_impact, route, model}. Also adding a parallel quieter signal (severity=alert) for monitoring/triage that doesn't page.
SRE Bot: Test-run in staging with synthetic load (p99=950ms) -> no page. With p99=1.2s -> page. Behavior matches expected gating.
Jia T.: InfraOps report after pool change?
InfraOps: After shifting 20% traffic, p99 for chat-large dropped from ~1.05s -> ~600-700ms within 90s; completions-lowlatency improved to ~520ms. We will keep light pool for 30m then scale down.
Rafael M.: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/alerts/pulls/789 contains rule, low-volume suppression, and per-model override JSON. Requesting review from @Jia T., @Priya V.
Priya V.: I'll prepare a short customer note template and post in accounts slack. No SEV calls needed yet.
Jia T.: Plan for prod rollout: merge PR after 30m of stability and then deploy to prod in a controlled window. Also create a new dashboard panel for p50/p95/p99 by (route, model, pool) and surface the baseline line (7d median). Rafael/Mike, can you add that to the incident folder?
Rafael M.: Dashboard created: https://grafana/internal/d/latency/incident-1765550000 ; added baseline ribbon. Saved snapshot and linked to PR.
InfraOps: Light pool scaled down at 1765552700, metrics stayed stable (p99 ~640-720ms).
SRE Bot: CI for alerts PR passed, staging smoke green.
Jia T.: Handoff: I'm on for another 25m then handing to @Rafael M. for overnight watch. Keep monitoring alerts and customer signals.
Rafael M.: Ack. I'll follow up with a short post-incident blameless note and propose whether runtime kernel revert or KV priming is needed in the postmortem.
Priya V.: I'll keep customer channel updated. Moving impacted accounts to "watch" status.
Jia T.: Thanks team. Short postmortem tomorrow. Closing thread for now.
Oncall Bot: Incident thread closed by Jia T. at 1765553600.
